changeSet.author: sondos
changeSet.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW reports.vwdiagnosticordertestsresult AS SELECT dor.id, dor.order_test_id, dor.profile_test_id, dor.result_value_number, dor.result_value_text, dor.marker, dor.approved_by, dor.approved_date, dor.rejected_by, dor.rejected_date, dor.rejected_reason, dor.review_by, dor.review_date, dor.processing_status, dor.normal_range_value, dor.created_date, dor.created_by, dor.last_modified_by, dor.last_modified_date FROM public.diagnostic_order_tests_result dor;

changeSet.author: sondos
changeSet.sql: GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA reports TO report_user;
GRANT SELECT ON reports.vwdiagnosticordertestsresult TO report_user;

rollback.sql: REVOKE SELECT ON reports.vwdiagnosticordertestsresult FROM report_user;
